description: This file defines the CandidateHistoryDecorator class, which provides methods to annotate and manipulate CandidateHistory entities with related entities (Candidate, Vacancy, Interview, Employee) and retrieve formatted information such as action descriptions and dates.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds convenience methods to manipulate CandidateHistory entities, associating related entities and retrieving formatted information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a CandidateHistory entity.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the candidate associated with the CandidateHistory entity by candidate ID.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the vacancy associated with the CandidateHistory entity by vacancy ID.

methods.name: setInterviewByInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the interview associated with the CandidateHistory entity by interview ID.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who performed the action by employee ID.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryAction
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the action taken in the candidate history, based on action ID.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the action was performed, formatted as a string.
